command:
set -u; echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(whoami); echo '===FILES==='; find /opt/entityos/cognition/titan_mx -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s %TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort; echo '===SERVICE==='; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-titan-mx.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===LEGACY-DBS==='; for p in ~/.local/share/agentzero/titan_mx.db /var/lib/entityos/data/titan_mx.db; do [ -f "$p" ] && ls -l "$p"; done; echo '===UNIFIED-TITAN==='; python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db'); c=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(p)+'?mode=ro',uri=True); rows=c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and lower(name) like '%titan%' order by name").fetchall(); print([r[0] for r in rows]); c.close()
PY
